observed_mechanics.VWAP: Cumulative Close*Volume / cumulativeVolume from supplied segment start; no daily reset
observed_mechanics.bands: VWAP plus/minus1.5*rolling20 Close standard deviation; pandas default sample std
observed_mechanics.entries: Lower-band reclaim for long; upper-band retreat for short. Signals and entry modeled same close.
observed_mechanics.exits: Close-observed fixed absolute stop/target distances, not intrabar barriers. No cost/spread/cash-admission/censoring protocol.
observed_mechanics.sizing: Fixed initial capital*risk_percentage/100 divided by fixed stop_loss_pips; no dynamic cash/capital cap
observed_mechanics.diagnostic_accounting_limits: Drawdown subtracts total_profit from peak account balance rather than current balance; open endpoint inventory not marked. Do not reuse reported metrics.

actual_source_defaults.EMA: TA-Lib EMA9 on close, native TA-Lib version/seed/arithmetic not pinned by repository
actual_source_defaults.VWAP: Daily date.floor(D) cumulative(H+L+C)/3*volume divided cumulativevolume; zero cumulativevolume falls back to close. Source prose UTC must be declared as input timezone contract.
actual_source_defaults.ATR: TR via np.maximum with shifted priorclose; firstTR NaN; pandas ewm(span14,adjustFalse), alpha2/15. First valid TR initializes smoothing, not Wilder14/SMA14 seed.
actual_source_defaults.cross: EMA>VWAP and previousEMA<=previousVWAP; close strictly above both at crossover
actual_source_defaults.arming: Search offsets0,1,2,3 inclusive; choose most recent tradeable cross whose intervening EMA>VWAP. Four eligible bars including cross itself, not three future-only bars.
actual_source_defaults.entry: armed and currenthigh>=armtrigger and unrounded arm_stop_pct<3.8. Offset0 trigger=currentcrosshigh, so high>=ownhigh admits same crossover bar without a later breakout. Later flags may recur while armed.
actual_source_defaults.cross_geometry: Trigger HIGH fixes recorded stop/target percentages; actual exits anchor parsed percentages to actual trade.open_rate. No hard entry order at triggerhigh.
actual_source_defaults.tags: Format stop_pct and target_pct with Python :.2f percent decimals; parse stored text into float. Targets/stops must use rounded tags, not unrounded ATR. Rounded ratio can depart from2; small stop rounds0.00, requiring literal callback behavior or declared invalid rejection.
actual_source_defaults.customstop: actualentry*(1-roundedstop_pct/100), raised to entry-(entry-liquidationprice)*.80 if available. Calls stoploss_from_absolute with tradeleverage or20; fallback -.99. Framework stop update lifecycle not established.
actual_source_defaults.customexit: current_rate>=actualentry*(1+roundedtarget_pct/100) checks before elapsed60hours timeout; rate observed by callback, not a submitted resting TP price. exit trend always0.
actual_source_defaults.other_defaults: minimal_roi0:10 remains fallback; stoploss-.99; process_only_new_candlesFalse; startup50; populate_indicators returns early without columns for dataframe length<40; can_shortFalse.
actual_source_defaults.orders: Entry/exit limit, emergency/stop market, on-exchange stop enabled with60second refresh; native pending/partial fill and callback/stop priority require runtime contract.
actual_source_defaults.leverage: min(20,exchange max), futures isolated in example config; source guarantee-like liquidation protection is unverified under gaps/funding/latency.
actual_source_defaults.example_config: Gate isolated futures,1USDT constant stake,100USDT dry-run wallet,max8open,tradingbalance99%; dynamic80volume-ranked assets/age>=3days, BTC and ETH blacklisted. Config example is source evidence, not verified deployed defaults.

sources.causality: Vector calculations are prefix-oriented on completed bars: daily cumsum and backward arming search use only current/past rows. That does not verify native closedbar/live callback timing. Same-bar high admission is source actual, not future data when full bar is already closed.
